President Russell M. Nelson taught, “Brethren, we all need to repent” (“We Can Do Better and Be Better,”Liahona, May 2019, 69). He further taught: “Repentance is required of every accountable person who desires eternal glory. There are no exceptions” (“The Power of Spiritual Momentum,”Liahona, May 2022, 98). President Dallin H. Oaks, First Counselor in the First Presidency, taught, “Repentance is an essential part of God’s plan.” He also said, “We must repent of all our sins—all of our actions or inactions contrary to the commandments of God. No one is exempt” (“Cleansed by Repentance,”Liahona, May 2019, 92). See alsonote 6in this article.
